facts.fact: 晨跑时 Max 到第三圈就把 Bryn 甩开，因为她从哨站回来后变得更快更强
facts.quote: By the third, the gap between us opened, not because she slowed, but because I was getting faster. Stronger.

facts.fact: Max 在第五圈追上 Bryn，放慢速度配合她，并转入人少的外道
facts.quote: I caught up with Bryn on the fifth lap and slowed to match her pace. We swung into the less crowded outer lane.

facts.fact: Bryn 说两人像在渐行渐远，Max 保证军阶不会让他们分开、她仍是自己最好的朋友
facts.quote: “Rank won’t define us, and it won’t separate us,” I said. “You’re my friend. We aren’t drifting anywhere. You got me?”

facts.fact: Max 走进食堂时全场停下动作转头看她，交谈和餐具声都卡住
facts.quote: Every head turned when I walked in.

facts.fact: 打饭的铁灰发女服务员不问就给 Max 多盛了一勺土豆，回头质问的男学员被她顶了回去
facts.quote: Then she reached back and added another scoop of potatoes.

facts.fact: Bryn 提醒 Max Delia 一伙会靠流言和名声从远处毁掉她，Max 只说自己有更要紧的事要想
facts.quote: They’ll work the rumors. The whispers. Chip at your credibility from a distance where no one can prove anything, until they ruin you.

facts.fact: Max 站起来当众要求全食堂停止流言与相互评分，强调一起作战、共同流血，引来零散掌声
facts.quote: We fight together or we fight divided. That’s the simple truth

facts.fact: Bryn 让 Max 下次干脆站到桌子上发表讲话，Max 拒绝；她知道食堂的平静不会持续
facts.quote: “Stand on the table next time,” Bryn said.

relations: Max 与 Bryn 同为跑步搭档，Bryn 担心两人因军阶不同而疏远
